verdict.rationale: The pack documents Customer Requests: feedback can be linked to Customer records, Asks from a shared Slack channel can be auto-associated with a customer, and attributes can sync from Intercom. None of this shows a developer-facing way to identify a logged-in end user at submission time so feedback ties to their existing account. The customer-level Slack/Intercom association is an adjacent feature, not the requested user-identification capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can identify logged-in users when they submit feedback so it ties to their existing account
